name: Nonorientable four-genus of 2,093 of the 3,525 knots with 11 to 13 crossings left open by KnotInfo (partial result)
target: gamma_4(K) for the prime knots with 11 to 13 crossings whose KnotInfo 2026.10.5 entry is an interval
result: Settled for 2,093 knots (465 at gamma_4 = 1, 1,628 at gamma_4 = 2) by one pinch move to a slice knot or to a knot of known gamma_4, with the published Arf and linking-form lower bounds; the upper bound of 575 more is lowered; 1,432 stay open. The third pass added 139 knots after the verifier gained a seeded complement test.

notes.formal: no Lean; every certificate is checked in Regina by crosscap4d/verify/verify.py in the repository, and construct/pinch.py checks the 139 new ones without topology
